data.why: The repository ships its own tiny synthetic ABF/CSV/TIFF demo files under examples/, and the WebGUI browses files by server-side folder path (default 'examples') rather than via an HTML upload form, so the bundled examples are already in the right place to use.

goals: Load a patch-clamp .abf recording and detect peaks/baselines across sweeps
Review an electrochemistry (photocurrent) CSV trace, align to stimulus, and export a figure
Open a fluorescence TIFF stack, draw an ROI, and extract per-frame intensity traces
Browse and overlay multiple CSV traces from a folder for quick comparison
Batch-process a folder of ABF files with filename parsing and export summary CSVs
Save a run manifest capturing the processing parameters used for a figure/export

review.summary: The tree gives an accurate, well-evidenced account of the reachable workflows: patch-clamp viewing and peak curation, echem pair detection and averaging, ROI quantification, and run-manifest provenance. Its labels are clean and the depth is sensible. Before filing it needs a task reordered (t4 before t5 contradicts the screens), the overlapping features f1/f2 and the oversized f7 recut, the failed restore step flagged, and half its nodes replayed, and it should state clearly that per-frame traces, CSV overlay and batch processing are not covered.
